newsitem.title: USA: Distillates sole gainers among US West Coast prods.
newsitem.headline: Distillates sole gainers among US West Coast prods.

text.p: U.S. West Coast jet fuel and low-sulphur diesel prices rose in an otherwise flat market, as potential demand from strapped Eastern regions lifted the products on Friday.
Spot demand received an added boost from NYMEX heating oil, which rose 1.77 cents a gallon to 74.06 cents.
"Jet and (low-sulphur diesel) are stronger and part of it's the Merc (NYMEX)," one broker said.
"If we don't move up and the Merc keeps moving, we'll ship it out of here," he said, referring to arbitrage opportunities out east.
